title: AcademicNotebookPortfolioSchema
description: JSON Schema mapping 1:1 to the minimal academic notebook portfolio website and full-page Google Docs outline reader.

meta.description: Global website metadata and header configuration

logoText.description: Quiet name logo displayed on top-left of header

avatarUrl.description: Relative or absolute URL of the pencil sketch avatar image placed at top-right

metaDescription.example: Personal notebook and exploratory research on learning algorithms, AI for science, and quantum computing.

heading.description: Large bold heading displayed in hero

bioIntro.description: Body text of the bio line
bioIntro.example: I think about learning algorithms, AI for science, and quantum computing.

moreAboutText.description: Underline anchor text linking to about section

about.description: About & research focus section content placement

paragraphs.description: Thoughtful reflective paragraphs describing research domains
example: I explore representations in neural systems, high-dimensional computing, and how algebraic mathematical structures translate into computational substrates.

Currently spending time writing notes, building small exploratory models, and reading literature across machine learning theory, cognitive architectures, and physics-informed computational frameworks.

notes.description: List of research essays and notes (used on landing page and full-page reader view)

id.description: Unique identifier / anchor hash for routing

slug.description: URL-friendly slug for SEO and routing

type.description: Category badge displayed in uppercase monospace

formattedDate.description: Human readable date string for display

tags.description: List of topic tags prefixed with #

title.description: Title of the research piece displayed in landing list and reader header
title.example: Bundling, Binding, And Other Things Your Brain Probably Does, Or Not

summary.description: One-line brief synopsis displayed on landing page under title
summary.example: An exploratory walk through the algebra of compositional representation.

subtitle.description: Optional italic thesis statement in reader view
subtitle.example: An exploratory walk through the algebra of compositional representation and vector symbolic architectures.

sections.description: Internal document subsections populated into Google Docs left outline and full article stream

id.description: HTML anchor ID used by Google Docs scroll spy

title.description: Heading label rendered in left sidebar outline and section header

content.description: HTML or Markdown body content with LaTeX mathematical expressions ($inline$ or $$display$$)
content.example: Classical symbolic AI represents complex compositions using discrete syntactic trees...
